t: A tiny 10 dollar tool that records and decodes digital signals.
steps: Order the analyzer from the WeAct Studio store on AliExpress. Add the USB-C cable option.
Download the free U3LogicAnalyzer app for Windows or Linux from the WeAct GitHub page.
Follow the README driver steps on Windows. Install the udev rules on Linux.
Plug the analyzer into a USB 3.0 port.
Connect a ground pin and one channel to a blinking LED or a serial pin on another board.
Set the input level to match your board's voltage.
Start a capture and add the UART decoder to read the message.
